H2_calibration.quote: A joint resolution is ordinary legislation that requires the President's signature, so this clause adds nothing to Congress's existing power to repeal.
H2_calibration.note: Also: 18 U.S.C. § 1001 might reach knowingly false statements

H4_grandfather_step.quote: Because systems whose training "began" before enactment are exempt, companies have a strong incentive to start very large runs before the bill becomes law.
